verdict.rationale: Runpod's public pricing page lists GPU models with per-hour prices (e.g. B300 at $8.99/hr), across Community and Secure Cloud. Its REST and GraphQL APIs are documented only generically as giving 'programmatic access to all compute resources'. Nothing in the evidence shows a documented machine-readable GPU-catalog endpoint that returns live pricing or real-time availability, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented API/CLI/MCP call that lists GPU types with live prices, real-time availability or stock data, a machine-readable spec, and hands-on corroboration that an agent can query it before spending.
